params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repoPath=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; git -C $repoPath fetch origin fix/updater-bom-e2e-20260929 --quiet; $sha=(git -C $repoPath rev-parse origin/fix/updater-bom-e2e-20260929).Trim(); $wt=Join-Path $HOME ('mhw-pr152-verify-'+$sha.Substring(0,10)); if(Test-Path $wt){git -C $repoPath worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wt -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; git -C $repoPath worktree add --detach $wt $sha | Out-Null; Push-Location $wt; try {;   Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA='+$sha);   dotnet restore .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};   dotnet build .\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.csproj -c Release --no-restore -p:NuGetAudit=false;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};   $runner='.\tests\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0\MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.exe';   & $runner --filter-class 'MhwModManager.IntegrationTests.UpdaterGitHubAssetDownloadTests';   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};   Write-Output 'PR152_FOCUSED=PASS'; } finally { Pop-Location }
